integrity: Outer independence makes the positive support a vertex cover. Matching size gives the support lower bound, and labels 2 and 3 contribute a precisely tracked excess above baseline positive weight. Equality is forced by the canonical half-graph maximum-independent-set staircase and the two leaves.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies minimum functions rather than all higher-weight feasible functions.
The H_2 and H_3 boundary cases are exhaustively certified.
Finite verification through n=5 is corroborative for the arbitrary-n theorem.
A differently phrased or non-indexed half-graph theorem may exist.
title: Minimum outer-independent double Roman functions of half graphs
